rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for referring to any person.

example.english: Anyone can come in and join.
example.traditional: 任何人都可以入嚟參加。
example.jyutping: jam6 ho4 jan4 dou1 ho2 ji5 jap6 lei4 caam1 gaa1

rows.note: Use this when the meaning is 'which person, whoever it may be' in a question or choice.

example.english: Anyone who wants to eat can take some for themselves.
example.traditional: 邊個人想食就自己攞啦。
example.jyutping: bin1 go3 jan4 soeng2 sik6 zau6 zi6 gei2 lo2 laa1

rows.note: Use this compact form mainly in patterns such as 任人都可以, meaning that anybody may do something.

example.jyutping: jam6 jan4 dou1 ho2 ji5 bou3 meng2
